scope: isolated portable-state codec; no model checkpoint admission or accepted-state forwarding

payload.record: 8 little-endian signed two's-complement integer bytes followed by one tag byte
payload.tag: 0 or 1; must be 0 for every nonzero integer

metadata.identity_rule: nonempty strings; exact equality to separately supplied trusted metadata is required on decode
metadata.identity_limit: codec equality does not authenticate a real producer, model, history, or KV artifact

lifecycle.initialization: explicit FP16 root lift only; no default state, reference-derived carry, or old hidden-state reconstruction
lifecycle.update: explicit state-plus-actual-addend transition; never substitute the FP16 view
lifecycle.save_restore: completed idle boundaries only; lossless payload; all metadata must match trusted context
lifecycle.reset: caller discards live state and pending payload; serialized old checkpoints remain immutable
lifecycle.kv: separate FP16 ownership; no KV bytes or opaque simulator saves are encoded here
